name: flipside
title: Flipside
description: Two-sided scanning for scanners with a one-sided feeder. Scan fronts, flip, scan backs, and get a correctly ordered PDF — driverless over AirScan/eSCL.
author: georg-wolflein

commands.name: scan-two-sided
commands.title: Scan Two-Sided
commands.description: Scan a double-sided document in two ADF passes and save a correctly ordered PDF.

commands.name: scan-one-sided
commands.title: Scan One-Sided
commands.description: Scan single-sided pages from the ADF into a PDF.

commands.name: reorder-pdf
commands.title: Reorder Scanned PDF
commands.description: Reorder an already-concatenated front/back PDF (e.g. from Brother iPrint&Scan) into correct page order.

preferences.name: scannerHost
preferences.title: Scanner Host
preferences.description: IP address or hostname of the eSCL scanner. Leave empty to auto-discover on the network via Bonjour.

preferences.name: saveDirectory
preferences.title: Default Save Folder
preferences.description: Folder pre-selected in the save dialog. Defaults to Downloads.

preferences.name: openAfterSave
preferences.title: After Saving
preferences.description: Open the resulting PDF once it has been saved.
preferences.label: Open the PDF after saving
